pageSub: Add the fields your team needs on each record. Retiring a field hides it; the values already entered are kept.
deniedBody: Managing custom fields needs the fields.manage permission. Ask an owner to change your role or add the permission.
deniedSupport: Support sessions cannot change custom fields.
loadErrorBody: The field definitions could not be loaded. Nothing was changed. Try again.
errorBody: Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
invalidBody: Some values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
noObjectsBody: The workspace has no record types to add fields to.
demoEditor: Demo workspace: the example fields shown here are labelled Example and changes are not saved.
demoFields: Demo workspace: these example fields are not saved.
conflictBody: Reload to see the latest version, then make your change again.
fieldRetired: That field is retired. Restore it before editing.
auditFailed: Saved, but the audit entry could not be written. Tell an administrator.
retiredKept: {label} retired. Existing values are kept and hidden.
limitReached: Your organisation is at its limit of {max} custom fields. Retire a field or ask your administrator to raise the limit.
keyTaken: A field with the key {key} already exists. Pick another key.
typeLocked: The type cannot change once records have values. Retire this field and add a new one.
reasonNeeded: Give a reason of at least {n} characters.
panelEmpty: No custom fields have been set up for this {noun} yet.
hiddenForRole: {n} more fields are not available to your role.
maskedValue: Hidden: you do not have access to this value
phoneHint: Saved with the country code, for example +91 98765 43210.
notUnique: {label} is already used by another record. Enter a different value.
emptyBody: Add a field to capture something specific to your {noun} process.
retiredBody: Retired fields are hidden from forms, tables and filters. Their values stay on the records and come back if you restore the field.
retireBody: The field is hidden everywhere. Values already entered are kept, not deleted. This is recorded in the audit log with your reason.
reasonHelp: At least 8 characters. Saved in the audit log.
reasonOptionsHelp: Records still use the options you are retiring. Say why. Saved in the audit log.
editorSub: Changes apply to everyone in the organisation and are recorded in the audit log.
labelTaHelp: Optional. Shown when the interface is in Tamil.
keyHelp: Used by imports and the API. Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
keyLocked: The key cannot change after the field is created.
typeHelpEditing: The type is locked once records have values.
sectionHelp: Fields with the same section are grouped together.
retiredOptionsNote: Retired options stay on records that already use them and cannot be picked again.
patternHelp: Optional regular expression the value must match.
ruleRequiredHelp: A record cannot be saved without a value.
ruleUniqueHelp: No two records in a workspace can share a value.
rulePiiHelp: Hidden from roles without the pii.read permission.
ruleFilterableHelp: Can be used to filter lists and saved views.
accessHelp: Leave all unticked for every role. People who manage custom fields always see the values.
editPermHelp: Optional permission key, for example leads.assign. Only people holding it can change the value.
